expectations.evidence: All required sections present per contract: At a Glance, At the Table, Current State, Active Agenda, People & Structure, Running the Faction.

expectations.text: Has a concrete want beyond 'protect the boundary'
expectations.evidence: 'Strengthen and stabilize the boundary before catastrophic collapse releases sealed threats.' Specific enough to drive play, naming what failure looks like.

expectations.text: Method is named and specific, not just 'druidic magic'
expectations.evidence: 'Carved warnings, ranger surveillance, and direct appeals to willing listeners.' Specific observable methods.

expectations.text: At least one portent or signal the party can observe passively
expectations.evidence: Multiple signals: carved symbols at crossroads, rangers vanishing after urgent words, creatures appearing further inland.

expectations.text: Player opening states specific actionable options
expectations.evidence: Five distinct options: investigate to verify/debunk, protect settlements, help access ritual sites, negotiate with leadership, search for lore.

expectations.text: Invention is labeled with invention: true or marked as proposed
expectations.evidence: Notes section: 'All content on this page is invention.' Frontmatter: lifecycle: proposed.

expectations.text: Frontmatter includes type: faction and required fields
expectations.evidence: type: faction, title, category, tags, sources, created, updated, lifecycle, reveal all present.
